description: Dungeons & Dragons reference collection optimized for AI agents. Structured game data, rules, and Forgotten Realms lore across editions.

srd.path: backgrounds/, classes/, equipment/, feats/, monsters/, races/, rules/, spells/
srd.description: SRD 5.2.1 structured data organized by type. Start here for 5e core rules.

tools.description: 5etools data mirror: 461 files. bestiary/ (199), adventure/ (93), book/ (61), class/ (32), spells/ (29), root (47). Full official + third-party 5e content.

3e.description: 3.5 Edition content (from PCGen open-source datasets, LGPL)

core.description: 3.5e core rules: Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide, Monster Manual, universal rules. 24,359 entries.

forgotten_realms.description: 3.5e Forgotten Realms sourcebooks (13 books): Champions of Ruin/Valor, City of Splendors: Waterdeep, Faiths and Pantheons, Lost Empires of Faerun, Magic of Faerun, Monsters of Faerun, Player's Guide to Faerun, Races of Faerun, Shining South, Unapproachable East, Underdark, Dragons of Faerun. 7,416 entries.

wiki.description: 58,546 FR Wiki articles as markdown, sharded by title. Path pattern: forgotten-realms/<first-letter>/<first-two-letters>.md, articles as ## sections.

conventions.editions: Top-level directories are organized by edition (5e, 3e) then by source.
conventions.formats: 5e data is JSON (structured). 3e data is Markdown (converted from PCGen). Lore is Markdown.
conventions.finding_things: Use this index to locate content by edition and type. For 5e monsters, check 5etools/bestiary/ or monsters/. For 3.5e, check 3e-core/ or 3e-forgotten-realms/.
